scope: 41 nonfinal source/access routes, including optional roles, narrated individuals, unperformed scenario actors, group occurrences and a nonperson object-provenance route. Not41 unique people.
identity_join_policy: Source/access routes are kept separate where positive correspondence is not established. Role-, class-, species- or artwork-based non-joins are provenance boundaries, not proof that two subjects must be distinct in every possible continuity. The guide receptionist/Luna possible correspondence and supply-store/captive-party correspondence retain their explicit qualifications.
